chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
“A person in chains does not lead those who are free, and a person afflicted with paralysis does not lead those who are healthy.”

key_terms.الْأَصِحَّاءَ: those who are healthy and sound
key_terms.الْمُطْلَقِينَ: those who are free and unrestricted
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْقَيْدِ: a person in chains or physical restraint
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads as the Imam in congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Who is not permitted to lead congregational salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning who may serve as Imam in congregational salat (prayer). It indicates that one who is physically constrained or impaired in the stated ways should not lead those who are unrestricted and healthy.
